An astronaut struggles to adapt to his changing world.
"Astronaut" by Joe Connor
Connect with the Filmmakers:
Director’s Statement:
What happens when the person we have spent our lives becoming is no longer needed? The film was originally inspired by thoughts of redundancy and mechanisation, but it now feels strangely prophetic. As artificial intelligence increasingly performs tasks that once defined our worth, the questions the film tackles feel even more urgent today.
